orders.text:
SA No. 114 of 2019 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
On account of the fact that I appeared 
on behalf of respondent No. 2 of the present 
Second Appeal in other connected matters in 
relation to the same set of property, hence, 
place the Second Appeal before another 
Bench, of which I am not a member. 
 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
Dated 29.08.2019 
Shiv

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Verma
orders.text:
S.A. No.114 of 2019
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, learned Senior 
Counsel assisted by Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, 
learned counsel for the appellant.
None appears for the respondent No.1, 
though Mr. N.S. Pundir, learned counsel has 
taken notice on behalf of respondent No.1.
Mr. Arvind Vashisth, learned Senior 
Counsel assisted by Mr. Shubra Rastogi, learned 
counsel for the Caveator/respondent No.2.
Mrs. Prabha Naithani, learned Brief Holder 
for the State of Uttarakhand-respondent No.3.
Heard learned counsel for the parties. 
Perused and gone through the records.
Admit the Second Appeal on the following 
substantial questions of law :-
(i) Whether the findings of courts below on 
issue Nos. 1 & 3 are based on misreading 
and misinterpretation of documents?
(ii) Whether the courts below are justified in 
holding that lease deed dated 05.04.2007 of 
plot No.309/2 executed by Zila Panchayat, 
Udham Singh Nagar in favour of Suresh 
Verma-respondent No.2 is valid?
(iii)Whether the suit filed by the appellant 
for declaration is barred by the limitation, 
since the appellant came to know about the 
lease deed dated 05.04.2007 only on 
06.02.2008?
(iv)Whether the courts below are justified in 
holding that the suit filed on behalf of the
appellant is barred under Order 23 Rule 1 
(4) and Order 2 Rule 2 of the Code of Civil 
Procedure, 1908?
Summon the lower court records.
Post on 11.10.2019 along with S.A. No.89 
of 2014.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
13.09.2019
JKJ
